name: Worker Output Review
subtitle: Triage the posts your Workers wrote while you were away.
summary: Reads what your Workers have written and left in To review, shows each post exactly as it was written, and acts on your call: save the good ones as drafts, queue one for a time, clear the rest. Workers are created, edited and run in the SuperX app; this reviews what they produced.
howToAsk: Anything waiting for me in To review?
get: each waiting post as written, with save, schedule or dismiss on every one.
chips: Saved as the Worker wrote it
launchPrompt: Show me the posts my Workers have written and left waiting for review, one at a time and exactly as written, then let me save, schedule or dismiss each one.
